title: Multi-output LSTM soft sensors for industrial anaerobic co-digestion using LSTM-beta-VAE generative data augmentation
abstract: arXiv:2610.39768v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Anaerobic digestion (AD) requires close monitoring of key process variables, including pH, the ratio of volatile organic acids to alkaline buffer capacity and biogas production, to maintain biological stability and prevent process failure. While mechanistic frameworks such as the Anaerobic Digestion Model No. 1 are highly parameterised, computationally expensive, and difficult to calibrate for real-time applications, data-driven Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks offer a potentially more adaptable alternative. However, current data-driven approaches in AD are predominantly limited to single-output architectures that focus solely on production yields, as opposed to simultaneous prediction of vital stability indicators. Furthermore, industrial AD datasets are typically sparse and skewed toward steady-state operations. translated_title: 使用LSTM-β-VAE生成式数据增强的工业厌氧共消化多输出LSTM软测量器
translated_abstract: 厌氧消化（AD）需要对关键过程变量进行密切监测，包括pH值、挥发性有机酸与碱性缓冲容量的比值以及沼气产量，以维持生物稳定性并防止过程失效。尽管诸如厌氧消化一号模型（ADM1）之类的机理框架高度参数化、计算成本高昂，且难以针对实时应用进行校准，但数据驱动的长短期记忆（LSTM）网络提供了一种可能更具适应性的替代方案。然而，目前AD领域的数据驱动方法主要局限于仅关注产量的单输出架构，而无法同时对关键的稳定性指标进行预测。此外，工业AD数据集通常较为稀疏，且偏向稳态运行工况。基线评估表明，这种数据稀缺性阻碍了标准算法（随机森林、XGBoost）以及未经数据增强的模型的表现。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种结合LSTM-β-VAE生成式数据增强的工业厌氧共消化多输出LSTM软测量方法，能够同时预测pH、挥发性有机酸与碱度比值及沼气产量等关键稳定性指标，并有效解决了工业数据稀疏且偏向稳态的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes multi-output LSTM soft sensors for industrial anaerobic co-digestion enhanced with LSTM-beta-VAE generative data augmentation, enabling simultaneous prediction of key stability indicators (pH, VFA/alkalinity ratio, and biogas production) while addressing the challenge of sparse and steady-state-biased industrial datasets.
